rv.q: But the comedy is hackneyed and toothless.
Otherwise I’d advise waiting for the Biltmore’s next tenant, as the Manhattan Theater Club ricochets back to respectability with a revival of Brian Friel’s “Translations.”
The evening here is little more than an elaborate situation comedy peopled with ugly one dimensional characters and vulgar situations.

cn.t: Critics unanimously pan this British import as shockingly inferior work, with crude humor and stunningly minor material failing to justify its Broadway transfer.
